title: research: match actual-width twiddle layout and validate diagonal caller
body:
## Problem and result

The retained outer layout and the newer actual-width root choose different chunk widths. The outer construction has `d=floor(p^(1/40))`, selects `g=d-1` axes, and lays out chunks using `K_d=floor(d^(1/500))`. [PR #3599](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3599) instead computes `K_g=floor(g^(1/500))`. At every nontrivial boundary `d=k^500`, the two widths are `k` and `k-1`. This changes the complete array extent and the selected physical bits. Enlarging a left extent to hide the cardinality mismatch still applies the wrong tensor.

This package proves the mismatch and constructs a matched layout, inverse layout and complete descriptors using `K_g`. It covers every common offset, top and bottom elementary round, singleton and mixed axes, and both directions. The common rounds already select consecutive equal-sized chunks, so this repair needs no additional general-support router. Layout movement and component-order conversion remain charged, and the old outer constructor still needs a correctly typed replacement.

The written counterexample survives final rounding: an admitted unit-disk impulse produces different p-grid outputs under the intended and naively substituted tensors. Exact checks also distinguish the production floor thresholds, including the actual caller's precisions divisible by six. The matched `K>=k` threshold is `(k^500+1)^40`, rather than `k^20000`.

## Conditional layer theorem and published diagonal join

The proof establishes the actual caller's record-size and dimension admission. Completed normalised butterflies, truncation towards zero, and signed polynomial permutations preserve the unit disk on the p-grid throughout all rounds. Thus `w=p+2` admits every required signed negation. [PR #3611](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3611) already supplies the one-packet width observation; this result proves its complete-round implication.

With `T=Mr` coefficients, the retained ordinary movement exponent `tau=99830289/10^8`, and root exponent `alpha=99827101/10^8`, the conditional bound is

```text
O(T p [d K + p K^(tau-1) + ell g^alpha log p]).
```

The remaining caller must provide the actual root/rounded return and a complete lifecycle bill `Q <= C M R(rw+A+p^3)+poly(p)`, with fixed simultaneous buffers, restored borrows and heads, and consumed previous outputs. Here `R<=ell` and `A=log2(M)`. Unknown charges are not zero. The narrower outer movement bottleneck and selected exponent remain unchanged.

During this investigation, Sagar Thakrar published [PR #3617](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3617) at `4bf091f415d6470b60a5062a08b0a47e5b12dbd7` and handed its fixed-h pass to this complementary audit. A separate addendum retains all twelve predecessor files unchanged and executes that actual diagonal between explicitly unpriced H, rounding and layout oracles. It supplies the fixed-h enumeration, extraction/assembly, packet rearming and head-return portion of Q. Its 38 roles include both full streams; the full pass is one-shot, so packet reuse does not establish reuse across rounds. [PR #3619](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3619)'s adjacent router is not silently substituted.

## Evidence and limits

- Original component: ten complete small cubes, 50 completed-round comparisons, seven structural rejection controls, and two actual [PR #3593](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3593)/[PR #3611](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3611) packet joins.
- Diagonal addendum: 12 positive completed rounds, 384 actual packet applications and 4,096 Gaussian coefficient comparisons. Positive diagonal tariffs total 19,566,850 actions. A separate 64-packet wrong-K pass disagrees at four coefficient positions.
- Both directions start from the same initial cube. This is not a forward/opposite full-transform round-trip claim. Fresh stage instances do not prove a physical all-round allocation schedule.
- Source-byte, strict typed-receipt, off-grid, one-shot and tape-lifecycle controls pass. Normal and optimised wrappers and independent same-session Git-free copies preserve bytes and modes.

The literal source executables cap `ell` at 32, while the nontrivial outer bands imply `ell>=45,812,984,491`. Finite fixtures corroborate the interfaces, not a production outer execution. No historical full diagonal suite, physical T74 production run, full supplier, formal-kernel proof or exponent improvement is claimed.

Registered reproduction and source-history commands:

```sh
GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1 python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/twiddle-matched-layer
GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1 python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/twiddle-matched-layer --check-source-history
```

Public head `328c40966b650f60b1d62cfb0b1d67b2b755eb62` has tree `190e192e4ad13556740bbfd8adee025ce6c7ebeb`, matching the reviewed local tree. All four registered commands, metadata/source pins, the 39-file committed-byte/source-history gate, and the official public export/check pass. An independent actual committed Git-free replay passes all four declared commands with empty stderr, preserving all 40 exported files, five directories, and the extraction-root mode. The 501,760-byte tar has SHA256 `2019c49110359ee81e4c990b554c666d40e22b0b2f310018529096cf0e1e782b`. The original and addendum receipts remain `33069d629d9684a9cdaa728641c6c6ee02424059a5ac58acf5e2c95599ebcae4` and `553be8d67783d69930768c8c8e94215eaed803cbcf60d527267291e46ac9a4dd`. Hosted CI will be reported after its actual result.

## Scope, provenance and handoff

This user-assigned `uniform-transfer-audit` continuation has changed, bounded scope under priority revision 6 and [claim #19015428](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-19015428). Canonical main remained `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90` at the fresh pre-submission fetch. The 10:24 API checkpoint covered every PR body updated since 09:58, with separate fresh visible Discussion reads; historical diffs and exhaustive Discussion pagination are outside coverage.

Only this package is added: 39 files comprising 25 retained inputs and 14 new proof, checker and metadata files. Original source pins and credit are retained; ancestor `a71efb6cfb2a53df145e207ddccc63815c4aabb8` provides the source bytes in this PR's own history.

Three useful next obligations are:

1. Implement the typed actual-width outer wrapper with identical complete-array order/extent, bit-order conversion and one final rounded H return.
2. Connect the diagonal across all rounds with paid descriptor changes, framing, output consumption/reset and exact simultaneous stock.
3. Improve the remaining outer movement bill through a separately admitted construction, retaining precision/error, spectators, ownership and the complete transfer implications.

Credit Nick Petalas for [PR #3493](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3493)/[PR #3593](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3593) and their lineage; Jose Manuel for [PR #2298](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2298)/[PR #3599](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3599), retaining Hiroki Kumazaki's factory/rate work; Sagar Thakrar for [PR #3611](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3611)/[PR #3617](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3617); and the retained positional, monomial and transform authors. Clear1nsight prepared this work with substantial OpenAI assistance from a root agent and three concurrent specialists. Same-session reviews are not independent human acceptance. New work is Apache-2.0; original licence and notice bytes are preserved.
